deadline.value: International applicants for Fall entry must apply by February 1; U.S. applicants by July 15.
deadline.quote: International Applicant Deadline | Fall Semester | July 15* | February 1

gre_general.value: The GRE General test is required, with minimum quantitative 161 and verbal 153 for the Mechanical Engineering track and quantitative 158 for Industrial and Systems Engineering.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Exam (GRE) general test is required with a quantitative score of at least 161 and 153 for verbal for applicants in the Mechanical Engineering track, and a quantitative score of at least 158 for applicants in the Industrial and Systems Engineering track.

fee_waiver.value: Mechanical Engineering applicants with a GRE quantitative score at the 80th percentile or better may get a fee waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants with a GRE quantitative score in the 80th percentile or better may be entitled to a waiver of the application fee.

entry_route.value: A master's degree in engineering or a related field is the basic requirement; direct entry is possible only in special circumstances.
entry_route.quote: The basic requirement for admission to OHIO's Mechanical and Systems Engineering Ph.D. program is a master of science degree in engineering or related field

notes: Tracks are Mechanical Engineering and Industrial and Systems Engineering; the program is saved under mech. The fee waiver contact is the graduate chair.
